content.comment_body: I'm working on scaling an analog sensor that outputs between 6 and 144 inches using a 4-20mA signal. I've set the gain at 0.14 and the offset at 6, which gives me a minimum of 6 and a maximum of 146 inches. My setup includes an analog amplifier that first scales the signal from 0 to 1000, followed by a second scaling stage to achieve the target range. Despite this, I'm unable to match the desired output range precisely.
Please avoid posting multiple threads about the same issue.

This thread is closed because the question was already posted elsewhere. The duplicate thread titled '4-20mA to 6-144 inches using [product_name]' was published in the [product_name] hardware section. Best regards, [user_name]
